description: The plot illustrates the relationship between the Activated Parameters Ratio and Eval PPL for different models. The x-axis represents the Activated Parameters Ratio in percentage, with a linear scale ranging from 100 to 25, marked at intervals of 25. The y-axis represents Eval PPL, also on a linear scale, ranging from 11.5 to 14.0, marked at intervals of 0.5. Four lines are shown: Transformer (red dashed line), Only MoHD FFN (grey square markers and solid line), Only MoHD ATTN (dark blue diamond markers and dashed line), and MoHD ATTN + MLP (blue cross markers and solid line). The Transformer line remains steady at approximately 11.5 across the x-axis. The Only MoHD FFN line starts at around 11.5 at 100%, decreases to about 11.4 at 75%, and then increases to approximately 11.7 at 25%. The Only MoHD ATTN line begins at around 11.5 at 100%, remains steady until 75%, and then sharply increases to about 14.3 at 25%. The MoHD ATTN + MLP line starts at approximately 11.5 at 100%, increases to around 11.8 at 75%, and further rises to about 13.2 at 25%.
